_readme: CAREER CONTROL FILE — the one place that decides how your career is presented. Roles drive: resume pages, cover letters, homepage career modes, and the profile switcher. Everything here REFERENCES other data files by slug/id; it never copies their content. See PERSONAL_GUIDE.md.

goals.headline: Grow from backend/AI engineer to technical founder, building practical software that solves real business problems.
shortTerm: Deepen backend, AI, and cybersecurity experience in current roles
Build public proof: projects, products, talks, and teaching
longTerm: Lead engineering as CTO and build PLS Tech Company into a lasting software company
goals._note: Edit freely. Aspirations only — not shown as facts anywhere.

roles.label: Backend Engineer
roles.audience: Recruiters and hiring managers for backend/API roles.
roles.summary: Backend Engineer specializing in Python, FastAPI, and PostgreSQL. Builds asynchronous REST APIs, secure authentication flows, and production-grade backend services, from a single AI-powered resume screening backend to a suite of five live FastAPI-based web tools.

letter.openingHook: I'm a backend engineer who builds asynchronous, production-grade APIs — most recently an AI-powered resume-screening backend I designed and shipped end to end.
letter.closingNote: I'd welcome the chance to talk about how my backend and API experience could support your team.

roles.label: Python Developer
roles.roleTag: Python Developer | Automation • Data Processing • APIs
roles.audience: Recruiters looking specifically for Python skills across scripting, data, and web.
roles.summary: Python Developer building production-grade tools end to end — data engineering pipelines, FastAPI web services, and automation utilities — with an emphasis on clean, tested, maintainable code.

letter.openingHook: I'm a Python developer who enjoys turning messy, real-world data and repetitive processes into clean, tested, production-grade tools.
letter.closingNote: I'd be glad to walk through how I approach data quality and automation in more detail.

roles.label: FastAPI Developer
roles.roleTag: FastAPI Developer | Async APIs • Auth • Deployment
roles.audience: Teams specifically hiring for FastAPI experience.
roles.summary: FastAPI specialist who has shipped five separate FastAPI-based products to production, plus an async AI resume-screening backend — covering JWT auth, async SQLAlchemy, Pydantic validation, and multi-provider AI integration.

letter.openingHook: FastAPI is the framework I reach for by default — I've shipped five separate FastAPI-based products to production, each handling real traffic with no sign-up friction for the user.
letter.closingNote: Happy to walk through the architecture decisions behind any of these tools.

roles.label: AI Engineer
roles.roleTag: AI Engineer | LLM Integration • Prompt Engineering
roles.audience: Roles focused on integrating LLMs and AI providers into real products, not classical ML/model training.
roles.summary: AI Engineer integrating large language models into production backends — from a Google Gemini-powered resume analyzer to a multi-provider AI routing system with automatic fallback across five providers.

letter.openingHook: I integrate large language models into real backends rather than treating AI as a demo layer — including a multi-provider routing system with automatic fallback across five different AI providers.
letter.closingNote: I'd enjoy discussing how I think about reliability and cost when building on top of LLM APIs.

roles.label: Software Engineer
roles.audience: General software engineering roles that want breadth across the stack.
roles.summary: Software Engineer with backend-leaning full-stack experience — from async Python APIs to client-facing websites and a Next.js/React healthcare platform — shipping real products for clients, a startup, and open-source use.

letter.openingHook: I work comfortably across the stack, but lean backend — recent work spans an async Python API, a Next.js/React healthcare platform, and client-facing websites shipped end to end.
letter.closingNote: I'd welcome a conversation about where my range across the stack could be useful to your team.

roles.label: Automation Engineer
roles.audience: Roles focused on scripting, tooling, and automating manual/business processes.
roles.summary: Builds Python automation tools that remove manual, repetitive work — from a data-sanitization pipeline for SME transaction records to a suite of no-sign-up utilities (compression, QR generation, link shortening) that run unattended in production.

letter.openingHook: I build Python tools that quietly remove manual work — a data-sanitization pipeline for SME transaction records, and a suite of no-sign-up utilities that run unattended in production.
letter.closingNote: I'd be glad to talk through how I approach automating a manual process end to end.

roles.label: Data Engineer
roles.audience: Roles focused on data pipelines, cleaning, and reporting rather than application backends.
roles.summary: Builds data engineering pipelines that ingest, clean, standardize, and structure raw business data for reporting and downstream use — including a production-grade sanitization pipeline for Nigerian SME transaction data and a business-intelligence suite covering ingestion through executive dashboards.

letter.openingHook: I build data pipelines that take raw, inconsistent business data and turn it into something reliable enough to report on — including a production-grade sanitization pipeline for Nigerian SME transaction data.
letter.closingNote: I'd welcome the chance to discuss how I approach data quality and reporting pipelines.

roles.label: Founder
roles.audience: Contexts where the founder/leadership story matters as much as the code — partnerships, collaborators, hiring for PLSTech.
roles.summary: Founder of PLS Tech Company, building and shipping a portfolio of AI-powered SaaS products and developer tools — from the flagship PLS Nexus platform to five live, no-sign-up web utilities — while personally handling engineering, product decisions, and go-to-market.

letter.openingHook: I founded PLS Tech Company and personally build, ship, and run its products — from the flagship PLS Nexus platform to a suite of live web utilities.
letter.closingNote: I'd welcome a conversation about how we could work together.

roles.label: Startup Founder
roles.roleTag: Startup Founder | AI SaaS • Product & Engineering
roles.audience: Investor-, partner-, or accelerator-facing contexts — leads with product vision over job-seeking framing.
roles.summary: Solo technical founder of PLS Tech Company, taking AI-powered SaaS products from idea to shipped software — architecting PLS Nexus as a modular platform (starting with an AI resume-screening backend) and building a portfolio of live tools that already serve real users, entirely self-funded and self-built.

letter.openingHook: I'm the solo technical founder of PLS Tech Company, taking AI-powered SaaS products from idea to shipped software, entirely self-built.
letter.closingNote: I'd be glad to share the product vision and roadmap in more detail.

roles.label: CTO
roles.roleTag: CTO | Backend Architecture • AI Strategy • Startup Engineering
roles.audience: Startup, healthcare-tech, and leadership contexts where technical direction matters.
roles.summary: Chief Technology Officer at Moi Doctar, an AI-powered healthcare startup — guiding technical direction, backend architecture, AI strategy, and engineering decisions with product and engineering teams. Also founder of PLS Tech Company, building and shipping AI-powered software products end to end.

letter.openingHook: I'm the CTO of an AI-powered healthcare startup and the founder of a software company, so I'm used to owning both the technical direction and the hands-on backend work.
letter.closingNote: I'd welcome a conversation about how I could help guide your technical direction.

roles.label: Presales Engineer
roles.roleTag: Presales Engineer / IT | Enterprise IT • Cybersecurity Solutions
roles.audience: Enterprise IT, cybersecurity, and solution-engineering employers.
roles.summary: Presales Engineer / IT at EESolutions Limited, supporting enterprise IT operations while building expertise in cybersecurity solutions, networking, and customer-facing solution engineering. Brings a software engineering background (Python, APIs, automation) to customer requirement gathering, demonstrations, and technical documentation.

letter.openingHook: I'm currently a Presales Engineer / IT at EESolutions Limited, combining hands-on enterprise IT and cybersecurity exposure with a software engineering background.
letter.closingNote: I'd be glad to discuss how my mix of IT, customer-facing, and engineering experience could support your team.

roles.label: Solutions Engineer
roles.roleTag: Solutions Engineer | Customer Requirements • Solution Design • Demos
roles.audience: Solutions-engineering roles (closely related to Presales Engineer).
roles.summary: Solutions-minded engineer currently working as a Presales Engineer / IT at EESolutions Limited: gathering customer requirements, assisting with demonstrations and solution design alongside senior engineers, and translating technical detail for customers. Backed by hands-on software engineering (Python, APIs, automation).

roles.label: IT Engineer
roles.roleTag: IT Engineer | Enterprise IT • Networking • Microsoft 365
roles.audience: IT support, infrastructure, and systems roles.
roles.summary: IT professional supporting enterprise IT operations at EESolutions Limited — technical support and troubleshooting across Windows and Microsoft 365, networking fundamentals, and technical documentation — with a software engineering background that helps with automation and scripting.

roles.label: Cybersecurity (Early Career)
roles.audience: Cybersecurity employers hiring for entry-level or early-career paths. Honest framing: experience is currently on-the-job and growing.
roles.summary: Software engineer moving into cybersecurity: currently gaining professional experience with cybersecurity solutions and enterprise IT at EESolutions Limited, alongside a backend background that includes JWT authentication, password hashing, and secure API design.

roles.label: SaaS Builder
roles.roleTag: SaaS Builder | AI Products • Payments • Backend
roles.summary: Builds SaaS products end to end — from the PLS Nexus platform to PLS Jarvis (multi-provider AI routing with a credits system and Paystack payments) and a suite of live web tools — handling backend, data, and product decisions.

letter.openingHook: I build SaaS products end to end, including AI routing, credits, and payment integration.
letter.closingNote: I'd enjoy talking through how I approach shipping and maintaining a product.
